verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for an LLM gateway that stores usage logs, analytics and prompt-library content, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no export feature: no bulk download, no open-format export of logs, analytics or prompts, and no account data portability. OpenAI-SDK compatibility only makes switching code easier and is adjacent, not data export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
